newsitem.title: ZIMBABWE: Zimbabwe says Mobutu invited to OAU summit in June.
newsitem.headline: Zimbabwe says Mobutu invited to OAU summit in June.

text.p: Zimbabwe said on Wednesday it had officially invited Zaire's embattled President Mobutu Sese Seko to an Organisation of African Unity (OAU) summit to be held in Harare next month.

Foreign Affairs Minister Stan Mudenge told a press briefing on preparations for the June 2-4 OAU summit that President Robert Mugabe's government had extended the traditional invitation rightly due to Mobutu as head of state.

No invitation, he said, had gone out to Zairean rebel leader Laurent Kabila who says his forces are ready to over-run Kinshasa if Mobutu, Zaire's leader for the last 32 years, does not surrender power to him.

"But if the Zairean issue has not been resolved by the time of the summit, and should the central organ want to hear from them, then the OAU chairman may wish to invite Kabila," he said in answer to a question on whether the OAU summit would bring Mobutu and Kabila together for peace talks.
